review:
A classic-looking 20-liner with two modern features. The wild can randomly boost wins with a multiplier worth up to 100x the bet, giving the base game the odd big moment.

Free spins come in tiers: every five scatters push the total multiplier up in Super Boost Free Spins, with up to 50x in Ultra Boost and 100x in Mega Boost. Up to 5,000x, 96.47% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
